A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''female''' served as a [[Chamberlain/Legends|chamberlain]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Serjay Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
